newsitem.title: USA: Trimedyne sells unit, sees $700,000 gain.
newsitem.headline: Trimedyne sells unit, sees $700,000 gain.

text.p: Trimedyne Inc on Monday said it has completed the sale of all the assets of its 90 percent owned unit, Poly-Optical Products Inc, in an all cash deal that gives it a $700,000 gain in the current quarter.
The unit was sold to Remote Source Lighting International Inc, a privately held company located in Raleigh, N.C.

Poly-Optical, a maker of plastic fiber-optic devices used for light, image and data transmission, generated sales of about $3.0 million and operating income of $252,000 in the fiscal year ended Sept. 30.
